newsitem.title: GERMANY: German unions, bosses to join in tackling jobless.
newsitem.headline: German unions, bosses to join in tackling jobless.

text.p: The heads of Germany's trade union federation and the engineering employers federation Gesamtmetall pledged to join forces in order to try and reduce Germany's record high jobless rate.

Speaking together on German television late Friday, trade union federation DGB chief Dieter Schulte and Gesamtmetall head Werner Stumpfe demanded innovative steps to combat unemployment and suggested more part-time work could be useful.
Schulte said the amount of overtime hours worked must be reduced, adding that a further reduction in the number of hours regularly worked could also help create new jobs.
Germany's unemployment rate climbed to 12.2 percent in January, from 10.8 percent in December, the highest in 64 years.
